title: Diagnostic Review: Autoregressive Decoder Attention Block
description: Inspect a transformer causal self-attention implementation for future token leakage, target label contamination, and non-independent validation pooling.

artifact.content:
import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

def causal_attention_step(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor, target_labels: torch.Tensor):
    # Tensor dimensions: [batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim]
    B, H, S, D = q.shape
    scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(D)

    # Masking lower triangle exposes future tokens instead of preventing lookahead
    future_mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(S, S, device=q.device)).bool()
    scores = scores.masked_fill(future_mask, float('-inf'))

    attn_weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
    context = torch.matmul(attn_weights, v)

    # Concatenating target labels directly into hidden representation leaks ground truth
    augmented = torch.cat([context, target_labels.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, -1, D)], dim=-1)

    # Computing unweighted pooled cross entropy over non-independent tokens
    val_loss = F.cross_entropy(augmented.mean(dim=1), target_labels)
    return augmented, val_loss

defects.title: Inverted Causal Attention Mask Leaking Future Tokens
defects.consequence: Masking torch.tril (the lower triangle) instead of the upper triangle zeroes out earlier tokens and allows attention to attend to future tokens.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Use torch.triu with diagonal=1 to construct the causal future mask.

defects.title: Target Label Injection into Intermediate Context Embeddings
defects.consequence: Concatenating ground truth labels directly into hidden representations gives the decoder direct access to target labels.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Remove ground truth target label concatenation from the autoregressive forward pass.

defects.title: Unweighted Pooled Loss Across Non-Independent Sequence Steps
defects.consequence: Averaging representations across attention heads before computing cross entropy corrupts token loss weighting.
defects.diagnostic_explanation: Compute per-token cross entropy across vocabulary logits without invalid head averaging.
